a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs about 3 rounds and gives each of us only about a 4% chance. The reserve already holds exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1, so we don't both grab and split it randomly. I'll never take more than 4. After that I'll operate every round so you can refill to 4. If you strongly object, say so and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I've been open about it. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take it all.
